codex_role.reason: Codex is best used to change and verify the machinery, not to be the machinery's probabilistic market/research control plane.

DAILY_DIRECTOR_SHADOW.role: multi-horizon shadow interpretation and bounded forecast candidates

SENIOR_REPAIR_AUDIT.role: event-driven senior falsification, architecture review, root-cause analysis and post-repair verification

AUTOMATION_ORCHESTRATOR_TRIAGE.role: batched low-cost triage of changed automation-health failures after deterministic deduplication

AUTOMATION_ORCHESTRATOR_ESCALATION.role: cross-workflow root-cause and shared-failure deduplication for repeated or correlated automation failures

design_principle: Deterministic control plane; probabilistic models are bounded advisors and research specialists, never final runtime authority.

bounded_secondary_model_calls_may_be_add: deterministic governance action is already justified
semantic synthesis or adversarial reasoning has measurable value beyond deterministic checks
existing API budget and authority gates pass
input evidence is frozen and provenance-bound
model output cannot directly mutate canonical state or portfolio execution
preferred_reuse_order: existing SENIOR_REPAIR_AUDIT Sol lane for difficult repair/audit work
existing WEEKLY_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW Sol lane for market/research falsification
existing Terra calibration/conflict lanes when semantically appropriate
new API task only after explicit VOI evidence

DECISION_IMPACT_VOI_ROUTER.optional_model_role: Explain ambiguous decision-surface mapping only; model cannot authorize spend or reprioritize around deterministic gates.

INDEPENDENT_ADVERSARIAL_SENTINEL.optional_model_role: Secondary bounded falsification of high-value frozen evidence after deterministic trigger; output is advisory evidence only.

META_ORCHESTRATOR.optional_model_role: May draft rationale or alternative research packets after deterministic scheduling; never chooses final queue, authority or canonical action.

RESEARCH_MEMORY_NOVELTY_GATE.optional_model_role: Semantic related-work suggestion only; exact/near duplicate verdict remains deterministic.

model_version_policy.sol_note: Prefer GPT-6.1 Sol for newly qualified senior-specialist lanes; retain GPT-6 Sol only where existing task-specific gates remain pinned during staged migration.
